title: Simulating two-dimensional lattice gauge theories on a qudit quantum computer
abstract: First quantum computation of 2D lattice QED using trapped-ion qudits. Demonstrates the basic building block of two-dimensional lattice quantum electrodynamics involving both gauge fields and matter. Uses qudits (multi-level quantum systems) encoded in trapped calcium-40 ions to naturally represent the high-dimensional gauge field Hilbert space, enabling much shallower circuits than qubit-based approaches.
key_claims: First quantum simulation of 2D lattice gauge theory with both gauge fields and matter on quantum hardware
Qudit encoding enables seamless observation of different gauge field truncation effects by controlling qudit dimension
Observed interplay between virtual pair creation and quantized magnetic field effects
Qudit VQE circuits are much shallower than comparable qubit-based implementations
Major step towards simulating 3D lattice gauge theories
